svg.title: Composite Simpson 1/3 rule on six subintervals
svg.desc: Seven evenly spaced points x0 to x6 form three Simpson panels, x0 to x2, x2 to x4, and x4 to x6. Each panel has its own parabola. Neighbouring panels share an end point but do not overlap. The weights 1, 4, 1 of each panel add to 1, 4, 2, 4, 2, 4, 1 at the shared points.
